tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm, never pure white.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, menus and inputs sitting on paper.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Control borders, inactive icons, the dot grid. Meets 3:1 on paper in both themes; never body text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the primary button fill. A warm near-black, never pure black. On paper and paper-raised (14:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, labels. On paper and paper-raised (5.9:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill (the primary button's label).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Honey yellow, the brand color, as a FILL: live/active indicators, the one highlight per view, yellow tags, discs and blocks. Too faint as a thin mark on light paper, so in light it sits on or beside ink, or as a large shape. Never text on paper in light.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal fill. Always dark ink (9:1), never white.

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Signal as TEXT: 'needs attention' status words and warning labels. On paper, paper-raised and signal-soft (5.7:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted chips and highlights behind signal-ink text.

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: Second accent, a dusty cobalt: links, selection, focus, and learning (memories added, agents improving). As text or fill on paper, paper-raised and cobalt-soft (5.6:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: on-cobalt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a cobalt fill.

tokens.name: cobalt-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted chips and selected rows behind cobalt text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done, healthy, approved. A teal, kept off the red-green axis so it never depends on hue alone against danger. As text or fill on paper, paper-raised and success-soft (5.2:1+ both themes). Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted chips and banners behind success text.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a success fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, failed runs, destructive actions. As text or fill on paper, paper-raised and danger-soft (5.2:1+ both themes). Always with a word or icon; never for 'needs attention' (that is signal-ink).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted chips and banners behind danger text.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a danger fill (the destructive button's label).

tokens.name: identity-clay
tokens.usage: Identity color 'clay': agent avatar tiles, an org's color, and chart series. Never status. White initials read at 4.9:1 or better; the same value in both themes.

tokens.name: identity-ochre
tokens.usage: Identity color 'ochre': agent avatar tiles, an org's color, and chart series. Never status. White initials read at 4.9:1 or better; the same value in both themes.

tokens.name: identity-olive
tokens.usage: Identity color 'olive': agent avatar tiles, an org's color, and chart series. Never status. White initials read at 4.9:1 or better; the same value in both themes.

tokens.name: identity-pine
tokens.usage: Identity color 'pine': agent avatar tiles, an org's color, and chart series. Never status. White initials read at 4.9:1 or better; the same value in both themes.

tokens.name: identity-lake
tokens.usage: Identity color 'lake': agent avatar tiles, an org's color, and chart series. Never status. White initials read at 4.9:1 or better; the same value in both themes.

tokens.name: identity-iris
tokens.usage: Identity color 'iris': agent avatar tiles, an org's color, and chart series. Never status. White initials read at 4.9:1 or better; the same value in both themes.

tokens.name: identity-plum
tokens.usage: Identity color 'plum': agent avatar tiles, an org's color, and chart series. Never status. White initials read at 4.9:1 or better; the same value in both themes.

tokens.name: identity-rose
tokens.usage: Identity color 'rose': agent avatar tiles, an org's color, and chart series. Never status. White initials read at 4.9:1 or better; the same value in both themes.

tokens.name: identity-slate
tokens.usage: Identity color 'slate': agent avatar tiles, an org's color, and chart series. Never status. White initials read at 4.9:1 or better; the same value in both themes.

tokens.name: on-identity
tokens.usage: Initials and role icons on any identity color.

tokens.name: chart-lake
tokens.usage: Chart series slot 1 (lake). A brighter step of identity-lake so marks separate; an agent's series always uses its own identity family. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: chart-olive
tokens.usage: Chart series slot 2 (olive). A brighter step of identity-olive so marks separate; an agent's series always uses its own identity family. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: chart-rose
tokens.usage: Chart series slot 3 (rose). A brighter step of identity-rose so marks separate; an agent's series always uses its own identity family. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: chart-ochre
tokens.usage: Chart series slot 4 (ochre). A brighter step of identity-ochre so marks separate; an agent's series always uses its own identity family. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: chart-plum
tokens.usage: Chart series slot 5 (plum). A brighter step of identity-plum so marks separate; an agent's series always uses its own identity family. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: chart-pine
tokens.usage: Chart series slot 6 (pine). A brighter step of identity-pine so marks separate; an agent's series always uses its own identity family. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: chart-clay
tokens.usage: Chart series slot 7 (clay). A brighter step of identity-clay so marks separate; an agent's series always uses its own identity family. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: chart-iris
tokens.usage: Chart series slot 8 (iris). A brighter step of identity-iris so marks separate; an agent's series always uses its own identity family. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, one hue (lake), low to high magnitude. Step 1 of 5. For ordered categories (tiers, funnel stages) use steps 2 to 5 only.

tokens.name: seq-2
tokens.usage: Step 2 of 5. For ordered categories (tiers, funnel stages) use steps 2 to 5 only.

tokens.name: seq-3
tokens.usage: Step 3 of 5. For ordered categories (tiers, funnel stages) use steps 2 to 5 only.

tokens.name: seq-4
tokens.usage: Step 4 of 5. For ordered categories (tiers, funnel stages) use steps 2 to 5 only.

tokens.name: seq-5
tokens.usage: Step 5 of 5. For ordered categories (tiers, funnel stages) use steps 2 to 5 only.

tokens.name: diverging-mid
tokens.usage: Neutral midpoint of a diverging scale; the arms are chart-clay (below) and chart-lake (above).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links. An alias of cobalt.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Space Grotesk for the wordmark, titles and headings. Tight tracking, never below 20px.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Marketing heroes and empty-state headlines. One per page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Checks the forecast each morning and flags anything unusual before you water.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata and helper text, in ink-muted.

groups.name: Instrument
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono: the instrument voice, kept friendly. Labels, readouts, code.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Control and section labels, status readouts, in sentence case. Short; never sentences.

spacing.note: 4px base. Generous around content, tight inside controls.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls, between tight rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gaps in a grid, the dot-grid pitch.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups within a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections; page gutters.

radius.note: Friendly but still made: soft corners on everything, pills for small status things, never blobby.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, small badges, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, agent tiles.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status chips, avatars, the signal dot.

shadow.note: Borders first. Three lifts: sm for cards at rest, md for anything floating, lg for dialogs. One focus ring.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: A soft lift for cards and agent tiles at rest, alongside their line border.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips and toasts: anything floating just above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets only.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px paper gap, then 2px of solid cobalt (6:1+ on paper in both themes).

duration.note: Short and purposeful. Only AgentState's running dots loop. Everything stops when the person prefers reduced motion, except those dots, which fade slowly in place instead of bouncing.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hovers, presses, color changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Switches, disclosures, menus opening.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Dialogs and panels entering; toasts sliding in.

easing.note: Things arrive quickly and settle; nothing bounces except the running dots.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default for anything appearing or responding.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Moving between two positions, such as a switch thumb.

zIndex.note: One stacking order for the whole app.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: The top bar and sticky table headers.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: The mobile sidebar drawer and its scrim.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, selects.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialog overlay and dialog.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above dialogs.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips, above everything.

layout.note: Widths and breakpoints. Layout is a sidebar plus one content column; content never stretches edge to edge.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: The org sidebar on wide screens.

tokens.name: content-narrow
tokens.usage: Reading and forms: settings, briefs, a single card.

tokens.name: content
tokens.usage: Default page column: inbox, assignment detail, chat.

tokens.name: content-wide
tokens.usage: Tables, the graph, dashboards.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Below this: single column, full-width buttons in dialogs.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Below this: the sidebar becomes a drawer behind a menu button.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Above this: room for a side panel next to content.
